title: 第5章 藏经楼
content_zh:
十几年来，姬长空曾多次幻想能够走进藏经楼，阅览里面的经书试图找寻出让自己聚集出元力的办法。

但当他今天真正进入了藏经楼，却有些茫然不知所措了……

多年来，每当姬长空想聚集元力的时候，都能够感觉到身体疼痛莫名，那种刻骨铭心的痛苦是那么的深刻强烈，以至于姬长空往往都会在中途就直接痛的昏厥过去。

然而，即便如此，十七年来，姬长空却从来不曾放弃过！

只要身体略微恢复过来，姬长空总是继续反复尝试，忍着那锥心的痛苦一次次地聚集体内元力……

很多时候，姬长空甚至隐隐约约能感觉到元力已在体内流转，但是一到这个时候，脑子就会传来一阵不可抵挡的剧痛，令他瞬间昏厥！

醒来之后，体内依旧没有元力在流转的迹象，所以姬长空只当那是他在昏厥之前，一霎那间的美妙错觉。

十七年来，无论他尝试多少次，结果都是一样。

或许正是因为这个原因，姬长空才会从小体弱多病，他越是努力尝试聚集元力，身体就越是一天不如一天。许许多多个深夜，在睡梦中姬长空都能够感觉到骨髓的隐隐作痛，然后在睡梦中就被直接给痛醒！

姬家儿郎从来没有人像他这样，就算是旁系子孙，即便还不能够立即聚集元力，也都是身强力壮，很少生病。而那些已经可以聚集元力的子弟，在聚集元力的过程中从来都是舒畅爽快的，没有人像他一样那么艰难，那么的痛苦不堪！

姬长空身体的异常，姬家内无人知晓是什么原因造成。就连小时候最疼爱他的爷爷姬逾胜，在反复尝试为他聚集元力，而无果之后，也不得不无奈的放弃，默认了他不能够成为天士的痛苦事实。

所有人都放弃了，可姬长空自己却从未放弃！

十七年来，不知道有多少个日夜，姬长空都是一人在默默地聚集元力，忍着那锥心的痛苦，一遍遍地尝试，直到昏厥才罢休！

然后，身体一旦恢复过来，又再一次继续努力，再一次昏厥……

有一天，当姬长空知道姬家有藏经楼这个藏放天士秘诀、秘技的地方之后，他就将藏经楼当成了他唯一的希望！今天终于站到了藏经楼里面，看着那一排排书籍，姬长空要不断地去深呼吸，才能够让自己保持冷静不乱，以免做出什么出格的事情。

藏经楼第一层书卷最多，三排紫檀木书柜架子上，稀稀落落的摆放着一叠叠经书。

不过，姬长空翻阅了一下，却发现摆放在紫檀木书架上面的经书，大多数都是阐述天士境界，述说一些基础修炼道理的杂书。

真正记载了天士修炼秘诀、秘技的经书，只有很少一部分，都放在这一层东角那个最小书架上。

而此时，那一块区域周围早已围满了姬家儿郎，姬长空想要挤进去怕是不容易。

姬长空看着将东角围得水泄不通的姬家儿郎，心中默默地思量着该用什么方法挤进去。然而，还未等姬长空靠近那边，就感觉一股大力从左肩涌来，猝不及防之下，姬长空身子一个跄踉，“蹭蹭蹭”斜着退了几步，重心不稳，一屁股坐在了地上。

“笨蛋，竟敢挡着我！”姬长乐冷哼一声，来迟了一刻的他，先是用力将姬长空撞倒在地，然后才轻蔑地看了姬长空一眼，冷笑道：“就你这废物，竟然也敢来藏经楼。哼，昨天就是因为你那一碟莴笋，才害我被父亲骂了！偏偏在测炼的时候，你竟然还要让我们姬家老小全部饿着肚子等你！你姬长空算什么东西？好大的架子啊！”

话罢，姬长乐又傲慢地瞥了一眼那些围在这一层东角抢着翻阅第一层天士秘诀、秘技的姬家旁系之弟一眼，旋即不敢浪费时间，“蹬蹬蹬”地往藏经楼第二层行去。

在姬长乐之后，姬长啸、姬长生、姬月晴、姬小莲这些姬家直系之弟也跟着进来了。

“长空哥哥，那么早你就来了？”姬小莲可爱地对姬长空吐了吐小舌头，摇着小手打招呼。

刚刚才从地上坐起来的姬长空勉强笑了笑，对姬小莲点了点头，却没有多说什么。

除了姬小莲之外，姬长啸、姬长生、姬月晴三人都未多看姬长空一眼，其中姬长啸、姬长生两人直接“蹬蹬瞪”地往更上一层走去，姬月晴则是昂首挺胸，高傲地拉在姬小莲走向第一层东角。

之前将第一层东角围的水泄不通的姬家旁系之弟，一见姬月晴拉着姬小莲走了过来，竟然你挤我、我挤你，硬是在那巴掌大的一小块区域内又腾出了两个位置出来，一个个讨好地笑着让姬月晴、姬小莲两人进来。

姬家家规森严，直系子孙在家族的地位远远高过旁系！当然，不能够聚集元力的姬长空，算是一个例外。

就算是直系子孙，不能够聚集元力成为天士，在以实力来说话的姬家，也只能够苟延残喘，忍气吞声，而没有丝毫办法。

姬长啸、姬长生、姬长乐、姬月晴、姬小莲这四个姬逾兴的亲孙子、亲孙女，之所以能够傲慢狂妄的对待那些姬家旁系子弟，除了因为他们本身的直系身份之外，最主要的还是由于他们有着比旁系子孙强大的多的天士实力！

不提姬长啸、姬长生、姬长乐这三个一直高高在上的姬家青年领军人物，就连姬月晴、姬小莲这两个女孩，也比那些旁系子孙强大。

今年的测炼，姬月晴、姬小莲两人分获第四、第五名！远远将旁系子弟甩在后面！

姬家家规其中一条，也是最重要的一条家规，――实力为尊！

就算是旁系子弟，只要有着超越直系子弟的实力，也一样可以在直系子弟面前耀武扬威，没人敢说什么！

家规摆在那儿，就连姬长空的亲爷爷姬逾胜、亲姑姑姬婉云，也不得不默认这个事实，只能够利用一些隐晦的方式来为姬长空争取一些利益。

“长空哥哥，你也过来啊！来之前，爹爹就说这层东角书架上的秘籍、秘技才真正有用，你快点来啊！”姬小莲在东角站下之后，可爱地朝着姬长空挥手，娇小的身子往姬月晴身旁努力靠了靠，想要再给姬长空腾个位置出来。

突然，那边东角姬家旁系子弟杀人般的目光，一起猛地射向了姬长空。这些人冷冷地望着姬长空，大有姬长空一旦答应，就要联手干掉姬长空的意思。

他们不敢对姬小莲说些什么，只能够用眼神来威胁姬长空。

姬家儿郎本就生的粗壮、高大，他们为了能够腾出两个位置给姬月晴、姬小莲两人，几个大男人身子已紧紧贴在一起了，此时若是再加一个姬长空进来，恐怕他们就不仅仅只是贴在一起了――要抱在一起才成！

想想几个虎背熊腰的青年你抱我、我抱你，亲密无间的样子，他们自己都会觉得恶寒！

姬长空还算识趣，在那些姬家旁系之弟欲要杀人般的森冷目光下，他苦笑着对姬小莲摇了摇头，婉言拒绝道：“算了，我在这边先看看。”

“小莲，快看看这一本‘青莲决’，还带个‘莲’字呢！”唯恐姬小莲任性，非要放姬长空进来，姬月晴赶紧翻出一本天士秘技递给了姬小莲。

“哦。”姬小莲没再坚持，她注意力一下子就被姬月晴手中的“青莲决”吸引了过去。

今年姬小莲是第一次过来，藏经楼的一切对她来说都是那么新奇，所以她很快就忘记了孤零零在外围站着的姬长空。

三天，我还有三天时间，一定会有机会！深吸了一口气，姬长空用力攥紧拳头。

content_en:
For more than ten years, Ji Changkong had fantasized many times about being able to walk into the Scripture Library, read the scriptures inside, and try to find a way to gather Yuan Power.

But when he actually entered the Sutra Library today, he was a little confused and at a loss...

Over the years, whenever Ji Changkong wanted to gather his energy, he would feel inexplicable pain in his body. The unforgettable pain was so deep and intense that Ji Changkong would often faint from the pain in the middle of the process.

However, even so, Ji Changkong has never given up in the past seventeen years!

As long as his body recovers slightly, Ji Changkong will always continue to try again and again, enduring the heart-wrenching pain to gather the energy in his body again and again...

Many times, Ji Changkong could even vaguely feel the Yuan Power flowing through his body, but at this moment, an irresistible severe pain would come to his brain, causing him to faint instantly!

After waking up, there was still no sign of Yuan Power flowing in his body, so Ji Changkong just thought it was a wonderful illusion he had for a moment before fainting.

For seventeen years, no matter how many times he tried, the result was the same.

Perhaps it is for this reason that Ji Changkong has been frail and sickly since he was a child. The harder he tries to gather his energy, the worse his health becomes day by day.Many late nights, Ji Changkong could feel the dull pain in his bone marrow in his sleep, and then he was directly awakened by the pain in his sleep!

There has never been anyone like him in the Ji family. Even the collateral descendants, even if they are not able to gather their energy immediately, are still strong and rarely get sick.And those disciples who have been able to gather Yuan Power have always been comfortable and refreshing in the process of gathering Yuan Power. No one is as difficult and painful as him!

No one in the Ji family knew what caused Ji Changkong's physical abnormality.Even his grandfather Ji Yusheng, who loved him the most when he was a child, had to give up helplessly after repeatedly trying to gather energy for him to no avail, acquiescing to the painful fact that he could not become a heavenly warrior.

Everyone gave up, but Ji Changkong himself never gave up!

For seventeen years, for countless days and nights, Ji Changkong silently gathered his energy alone, endured the heart-wrenching pain, and tried over and over again until he fainted!

Then, once the body recovers, it resumes its efforts and faints again...

One day, when Ji Changkong learned that Ji's family had a Buddhist Scripture Library, a place where the secrets and techniques of the heavenly warriors were hidden, he regarded the Scripture Library as his only hope!Today, I finally stood in the Scripture Collection Building. Looking at the rows of books, Ji Changkong had to take deep breaths constantly to keep himself calm and calm, so as not to do anything outrageous.

The first floor of the Sutra Collection Building has the most books. There are stacks of Sutras scattered on three rows of rosewood bookcases and shelves.

However, Ji Changkong flipped through it and found that most of the scriptures placed on the rosewood bookshelf were miscellaneous books that explained the realm of heavenly beings and explained some basic principles of cultivation.

There are only a few scriptures that actually record the secrets and techniques of the Celestial Masters' cultivation, and they are all placed on the smallest bookshelf in the east corner of this floor.

At this time, that area was already surrounded by people from the Ji family, and it might not be easy for Ji Changkong to squeeze in.

Ji Changkong looked at the children of the Ji family who had surrounded the east corner, and silently thought about how to squeeze in.However, before Ji Changkong could get closer, he felt a strong force coming from his left shoulder. Unprepared, Ji Changkong staggered, took a few steps back diagonally, lost his center of gravity, and sat down on the ground.

"Idiot, how dare you block me!" Ji Changle snorted coldly. Being a moment late, he first knocked Ji Changkong to the ground with force, then gave Ji Changkong a contemptuous look and sneered: "You are a waste, how dare you come to the Sutra Collection Building?Humph, it was because of your plate of lettuce that I was scolded by my father!You actually made us, the Ji family, wait for you hungry!What kind of arrogance are you, Ji Changkong?"

After saying that, Ji Changle glanced arrogantly at the younger brothers of the Ji family who were gathered around the east corner of this floor, rushing to read the secrets and techniques of the Celestial Scholars on the first floor. He immediately did not dare to waste time and walked to the second floor of the Sutra Collection Building.

After Ji Changle, Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng, Ji Yueqing, Ji Xiaolian and other direct brothers of the Ji family also came in.

"Brother Changkong, you're here so early?" Ji Xiaolian cutely stuck out her tongue at Ji Changkong and waved her hand in greeting.

Ji Changkong, who just sat up from the ground, forced a smile and nodded to Ji Xiaolian, but didn't say much.

Except for Ji Xiaolian, Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng, and Ji Yueqing did not take another look at Ji Changkong. Among them, Ji Changxiao and Ji Changsheng walked directly to the upper floor with "stomp and glare", while Ji Yueqing held her head high and proudly pulled Ji Xiaolian towards the east corner of the first floor.

The younger brothers of the Ji family, who had previously surrounded the east corner of the first floor, saw Ji Yueqing pulling Ji Xiaolian over. They squeezed me and squeezed you. They just vacated two more places in the small area the size of a palm and let Ji Yueqing and Ji Xiaolian in with a flattering smile.

The Ji family has strict family rules, and the status of direct descendants in the family is much higher than that of collateral descendants!Of course, Ji Changkong, who was unable to gather Yuan Power, was an exception.

Even if the direct descendants cannot gather their energy to become heavenly warriors, in the Ji family, where strength speaks for itself, they can only linger on and swallow their anger without the slightest recourse.

Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng, Ji Changle, Ji Yueqing, and Ji Xiaolian, the four grandsons and granddaughters of Ji Yuxing, are able to treat the collateral descendants of the Ji family arrogantly, not only because of their direct status, but also because they have much more powerful Heavenly Scholars than the collateral descendants!

Not to mention Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng, and Ji Changle, the three young leaders of the Ji family who have always been aloof, even the two girls Ji Yueqing and Ji Xiaolian are more powerful than those collateral descendants.

In this year's test, Ji Yueqing and Ji Xiaolian ranked fourth and fifth respectively!Leaving the descendants of the collateral clan far behind!

One of the Ji family rules is also the most important one - strength is respected!

Even the collateral descendants, as long as they have strength that surpasses the direct descendants, can still show off their power in front of the direct descendants, and no one dares to say anything!

The family rules were there, and even Ji Changkong's grandfather Ji Yusheng and aunt Ji Wanyun had to acquiesce to this fact and could only use some obscure methods to gain some benefits for Ji Changkong.

"Brother Changkong, come here too! Before I came, dad said that the secret books and secret skills on the bookshelf in the east corner are really useful. Come quickly!" After Ji Xiaolian stood in the east corner, she waved cutely to Ji Changkong, and her petite body tried to move closer to Ji Yueqing, hoping to make room for Ji Changkong.

Suddenly, the murderous gazes of the children of the Ji family in Dongjiao over there suddenly shot towards Ji Changkong.These people looked at Ji Changkong coldly, indicating that once Ji Changkong agreed, they would join forces to kill Ji Changkong.

They did not dare to say anything to Ji Xiaolian, and could only threaten Ji Changkong with their eyes.

Ji Jiaerlang is naturally strong and tall. In order to free up two places for Ji Yueqing and Ji Xiaolian, the bodies of the several grown men are already close to each other. If another Ji Changkong comes in at this time, I am afraid that they will not just stick together - they will have to hug each other!

Thinking about a few hunky-backed young people hugging me and me hugging you, how intimate they are, they themselves will feel chilly!

Ji Changkong was quite sensible. Under the cold eyes of the younger brothers of the Ji family who wanted to kill, he smiled bitterly and shook his head at Ji Xiaolian. He politely refused and said, "Forget it, I'll take a look here first."

"Xiaolian, look at this book of 'Qinglian Jue', it even has the word 'Lotus' in it!" Lest Ji Xiaolian be willful and insist on letting Ji Changkong in, Ji Yueqing quickly pulled out a book of Secret Techniques of Heavenly Masters and handed it to Ji Xiaolian.

"Oh." Ji Xiaolian didn't insist anymore. Her attention was immediately attracted by the "Qinglian Jue" in Ji Yueqing's hand.

This was Ji Xiaolian's first time coming here this year, and everything in the Sutra Library was so novel to her, so she quickly forgot about Ji Changkong standing alone outside.

Three days, I still have three days, I will definitely have a chance!Taking a deep breath, Ji Changkong clenched his fists hard.
